+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: Correct every doc claim that names the Router
+---
+## What
+
+Five files tell a reader that this package depends on `FoundationModelsRouter`, and give that dependency as the reason for the macOS 27 floor and for the absence of iOS support. After the graph is clean, each of those statements is false. Correct them.
+
+The macOS 27 floor itself does not change. It is correct, but its reason is different: `FoundationModelsExtras` declares macOS 27, and FoundationModels v2 needs macOS 27. Only the reason text changes.
+
+The "iOS is unsupported" posture also does not change. `FoundationModelsExtras` is macOS-only. Keep the conclusion and correct the reason.
+
+### The files and the passages
+
+- `Package.swift:18-27` — the doc comment on `swissArmyHammerOrg` names Router and the "Conflicting identity" chain through Router.
+- `Package.swift:57-62` — the `platforms:` comment says the floor is inherited from Router.
+- `Package.swift:82-85` — the `FoundationModelsMetadataRegistry` dependency comment says "Router-backed selection session". It is now an `AgentSession`-backed selection session, and a plain `LanguageModelSession` conforms.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/FoundationModelsSkills.swift:21-31` — the iOS posture text names Router as the macOS 27 cause, and it names `FoundationModelsOperationTool`, a repository that was retired on 2026-08-29.
+- `docs/development.md:47-66` — the "Conflicting identity" note and the `mlx-swift` bundle-warning note. The warning is gone with the graph, thus delete that note.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/HotReloadLiveTests.swift:12-36` — a long "deviation from a literal Router-backed twin" disclosure. There is no Router to deviate from. Shorten it to say what the suite does.
+- `plan.md` decisions #17 and #26, and the §7 architecture block — record the change as an amendment. Do not rewrite the history of the decision.
+
+- [ ] Correct the three `Package.swift` comments.
+- [ ] Correct the namespace enum doc comment.
+- [ ] Correct `docs/development.md`.
+- [ ] Correct the `HotReloadLiveTests` header.
+- [ ] Amend `plan.md` decisions #17 and #26.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] No file in `Sources/`, `Tests/`, `Examples/`, `docs/`, or `Package.swift` states that this package depends on `FoundationModelsRouter`.
+- [ ] `Package.swift` gives the macOS 27 floor a correct reason: `FoundationModelsExtras` and FoundationModels v2.
+- [ ] `FoundationModelsSkills.swift` gives the iOS posture a correct reason: `FoundationModelsExtras` is macOS-only. It no longer names the retired `FoundationModelsOperationTool` repository.
+- [ ] `docs/development.md` no longer holds the `mlx-swift` bundle-warning note.
+- [ ] `plan.md` records the change as an amendment to decisions #17 and #26.
+- [ ] Every text written in this task is ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Add a test case to `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/DependencyGraphTests.swift`. It walks `Sources/`, `Package.swift`, and `docs/`, and it asserts that no file holds the string `FoundationModelsRouter`. Fail with a message that names each file and line.
+- [ ] Allow `plan.md` and `Tests/` to be exempt from that check: `plan.md` keeps the historical record, and a test may name Router in an amendment note. State the exemption in the test's doc comment.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
